subject: Before you shop online this week
preheader: Spotting fake shops, bookmarks that keep you safe, and a Thanksgiving plan from AI.
intro: Holiday shopping season is here, and so are the fake stores. Here's how to spot them.

sections.label: Scam of the week
sections.title: Fake online shops
paragraphs: Prices look amazing, the photos look great, and the website is brand new. You pay, and nothing arrives.
bullets: Check the web address. Look for misspellings or odd endings.
Search the shop's name plus "reviews" before you buy.
Pay with a credit card, not a debit card or a bank transfer. Credit cards give you more protection if something goes wrong.
If a deal looks too good to be true, it usually is.

sections.label: Tip of the week
sections.title: Bookmark the sites you use
paragraphs: Open your bank, pharmacy and favorite shops from a bookmark, never from a link in an email or text.
bullets: Open the site you use often.
Find the bookmark or star option in your browser's menu and add it.
Next time, go through your bookmarks.

sections.label: AI trick of the week
sections.title: Turn a rough idea into a plan
paragraphs: Hosting a holiday meal? AI makes a decent first plan.
sections.prompt: Help me plan a simple Thanksgiving dinner for 6 people, one of them vegetarian. Give me a shopping list and a schedule for the day.
sections.note: Tell it what you already have at home and it will shorten the list.
